item.description: A software defect that remained dormant for months, a routine network failover and a temporary reduction in server capacity collectively triggered a global outage.

item.title: AI stocks face correction risk as US Fed flags Big Tech debt, rising data centre costs and stretched valuations
item.description: The US Federal Reserve has flagged rising debt, circular financing and stretched valuations in the AI sector as financial stability risks. A slowdown in AI returns could trigger a stock market correction and expose lenders and investors to losses.

item.title: Motorola Signature 27 battery controversy: Why could some buyers get a 5,500mAh battery instead of 7,000mAh?
item.description: Motorola Signature 27 is advertised with a 7,000mAh battery, but EU regulatory records show another variant with a 5,500mAh unit. The difference has raised questions about regional specifications and what buyers can expect.

item.title: Intel Core Ultra 7 260K arrives as a limited-edition CPU: Why is the new Arrow Lake processor hard to buy separately?
item.description: Intel has confirmed the Core Ultra 7 260K as a limited-availability desktop processor. The 20-core Arrow Lake chip is currently available through select Newegg ABS gaming desktops, but buyers cannot purchase it separately as a boxed CPU.

item.title: China flies 19-seater battery-powered aircraft for first time: How far can it travel?
item.description: China's 19-seat CE-25A electric passenger aircraft, developed by COMAC and partners including CATL, has completed its first piloted flight in Shandong. The 10-tonne aircraft offers a range of around 400 km and a cruising speed of 300 kmph.&nbsp;

item.title: Mint Explainer | Why recent tech failures trigger concerns over digital resilience
item.description: A Microsoft outage and a FAA ground stop in the US unfolded within hours, prompting questions about the resilience of digital and AI-led automated systems. How vulnerable are critical services in an increasingly interconnected digital world?

item.title: DPDP rules may boost demand for cybersecurity professionals and security services: Report
item.description: The implementation of the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Rules is expected to create fresh demand for cybersecurity professionals and managed security services in India, as companies strengthen their systems to protect personal data, monitor security risks and respond to potential data breaches.

item.title: Apple plans Siri-powered smart glasses for 2027 with Uber, Amazon and Starbucks app integrations
item.description: Apple is reportedly developing Siri-powered smart glasses for a 2027 launch, with third-party app integrations allowing users to book rides, order food and shop using voice commands.

item.title: Apple launches AI health study app in partnership with OpenEvidence: Who can participate and how it works
item.description: Apple has launched a new AI health study app in partnership with OpenEvidence to examine how people use AI for medical information.

item.title: AI could reshape banking economics as early adopters see nearly 3x returns: McKinsey
item.description: Banks adopting artificial intelligence (AI) agents could see their investments pay off in around 10 months and generate returns of nearly three times the initial investment over three years, according to a report by McKinsey, which said the technology could reshape the economics and competitive landscape of the banking sector.

item.description: Despite the excitement surrounding the release, Rockstar Games has kept details of GTA 6 closely guarded. Its strict secrecy extends even to the people who helped create the original game.

item.title: From Microsoft 365 to CrowdStrike - Biggest tech outages that almost brought the world to a standstill
item.description: A Microsoft 365 outage that began November 12 disrupted email and other services for days before being resolved Saturday. It joins a series of major global technology failures in recent years, including incidents affecting Windows devices, Meta platforms, AWS, and Google.

item.title: Wondering what to gift friends and family this Thanksgiving? Get a $100 Google Play gift card for $92 | Here’s how
item.description: With the holiday season approaching in the US, Newegg is offering an $8 discount on a $100 Google Play gift card, bringing its price down to $92. Here's how to claim the deal and what you can use the gift card for.

item.title: Apple may launch three new iPhones in early 2027: iPhone 18, 18e and Air 2; what to expect
item.description: Apple may launch the iPhone 18, iPhone 18e and iPhone Air 2 in early 2027, potentially in March. Expected upgrades include the A20 chipset, better battery life, camera improvements and iOS 27. Prices in India could start at ₹79,900, though Apple has yet to confirm details.

item.title: Microsoft says services recovering gradually; here's how companies are resorting to traditional methods amid disruption
item.description: Microsoft, which says more than 430 million people use its Microsoft 365 services, acknowledged the disruption and said it was working to restore normal operations.

item.title: Sony PS5 sales cross 100 million worldwide: Why GTA 6 could trigger a fresh PlayStation 5 buying rush before its launch
item.description: Sony's PlayStation 5 has crossed 100 million units in cumulative sales to retailers worldwide. With GTA 6 set to launch on November 19, 2026, the highly anticipated game could drive fresh PS5 console demand and boost Sony's gaming business.

item.title: Anthropic Claude AI down, Status update: Services including Claude API, Claude Code, connectors down
item.description: Anthropic is investigating reports of degraded performance affecting Claude.ai, its API, Claude Code and other services on Friday. Users reported authentication problems and difficulty accessing the chatbot and coding tools.

item.title: Zohran Mamdani backs bill to end ‘surveillance pricing’: How NYC mayor aims to stop firms from misusing your data
item.description: New York City Council has passed a bill banning companies from using personal data, browsing history and shopping habits to charge customers different prices for identical products and services.&nbsp;

item.title: Microsoft outage affects businesses, government agencies and AI platforms: Full list of services impacted
item.description: A global Microsoft outage has disrupted Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, Copilot and several other services across multiple countries, affecting businesses, government agencies and third-party platforms.

item.title: Microsoft services down: Air India reroutes emails, IndiGo and Akasa warn passengers of support delays
item.description: A global Microsoft outage has disrupted email-based customer support services for IndiGo and Akasa Air, prompting both airlines to issue passenger advisories. Passengers have been advised to use alternative support channels for urgent assistance as email services experience delays.

item.title: Microsoft outage disrupts airline communication services; Indian carriers issue passenger advisories
item.description: A global Microsoft service outage has disrupted airline operations worldwide, prompting major Indian carriers to issue passenger advisories.

item.title: Microsoft outage crosses 12 hours: Outlook, Teams, Copilot and other services – what's working and what's down?
item.description: Microsoft is investigating infrastructure failures that have disrupted access to its cloud-based services. Its attempts to restore affected servers and rebalance traffic have not worked as expected, prolonging the disruption.

item.title: Samsung Galaxy S25 5G gets 48% off, effective price drops to ₹29,211 on Flipkart; here's how
item.description: The Samsung Galaxy S25 5G (12GB RAM, 128GB storage) is listed at ₹54,999 on Flipkart, with exchange and bank offers bringing its effective price down to ₹29,211. Buyers can also explore the 256GB variant at ₹60,999, with additional savings subject to eligibility.

item.title: AIs biggest risk lies in concentration of capital and power, warns NITI Aayogs Debjani Ghosh
item.description: Concentration of capital, influence and funding among a handful of companies could create systemic risks for the artificial intelligence industry, with circular financing making it difficult to distinguish genuine market demand from investments supporting the same ecosystem, Debjani Ghosh, Distinguished Fellow at NITI Aayog, warned.
